newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle active at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was active in the Panhandle area Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were mostly $1.00 per cwt higher.

Feedlots reporting good inquiry from buyers. Best demand for steers, while heifers under 1050 lbs finding narrow outlets. Sales reported on 27,200 slaughter steers and 11,500 slaughter heifers. There were 60,100 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 14,400 formulated cattle to be shipped this week.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 68.00 to mostly 69.00. Pen Mostly Select 1100 lb corrienties 67.00. Few dressed basis Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1250 lbs 110.75.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 68.00 to mostly 69.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 67.00-68.50.
Confirmed - 38,700 Week Ago - None Year Ago - 200
Wk to Date - 60,100 Week Ago - 16,500 Year Ago - 12,800
